venue.name: [Strathcona Community Center](http://www.strathcona.ca/departments/facility-services/community-centre/)
venue.address: 401 Festival Ln, Sherwood Park, AB T8A 5T8
venue.details: The room that will be used is the Agora

items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Implementation of 4-Pad
The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026).

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77333-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77334-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

•
### Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77333-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77334-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 15% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OdivelasFTORumble2027#77337-associados-aps-aps-associates).
